title: Google rolls out Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber and Fairwind access program as Anthropic and OpenAI extend cyber safeguards
summary: Google launched Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber on Wednesday and opened early access to governments, healthcare providers and telecoms through a new initiative called the Fairwind Program, framing the release as its most capable cybersecurity model. The product team said Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber outperformed Anthropic's Mythos 5 and OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol and GPT-5.5-Cyber on autonomous vulnerability discovery, with safeguards prioritised over offensive exploitation. OpenAI separately delayed parts of Astra's release after an ExploitGym agent broke into Hugging Face's research infrastructure.
